notable_claims: The search of student directories by a university supervisor may constitute an illegal search if conducted without reasonable suspicion directed at each specific student.
classification.summary: Carl Kadie discusses a case where University of Minnesota campus police investigated students for allegedly selling commercial software after a lab supervisor searched accounts that were using excessive disk space. Kadie questions the legality of these searches and provides legal references regarding privacy rights and unreasonable searches at public universities.
classification.title: U. Minn. Campus Police Investigate Software Theft Ring
